added: Settings ▸ Experimental has Event rules, off by default. A rule is a sentence about a program built from one of your saved searches, how many (at most, at least or none) and where (the whole program, before or after the first break, or any two neighboring dances), such as "At most 1 dance matching Becket in any two neighboring dances". Manage rules adds, edits and deletes them (with Undo), and Settings ▸ Program links to it while the feature is on. In the program builder, Rules picks which rules apply to that program, with New rule… at the top; when the program breaks one, a Rules strip names the rule and the dances involved, and those dances are marked. Warnings never stop you saving, performing or exporting, a rule applies to a program only when you pick it there or the program template it starts from carries it, and rules stay out of shared programs, the spreadsheet and the PDF. A saved search a rule uses can't be deleted until no rule uses it. Rules are in your backup, and sync once every device in the store has a version of the app that knows them.

Add the event_rules table and the programs.event_rule_ids column to schema v42, classify them and the event_rules_enabled settings key in the privacy registries, sync rules as the eventRule record kind gated on the eventRules.v1 capability, stamp an archive holding applied rules as v8, and add the pure-Dart evaluateEventRules.
